profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Space and Airborne Systems | L3Harris Technologies
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer at L3Harris Technologies, specializing in various stages of the software development life cycle. Proficient in Python, Java, DevOps tools, AWS services, and Big Data technologies. I hold a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) degree in Computer Engineering from the University of Puerto Rico at Mayagüez (UPRM) and a Master of Science (M.S.) degree in Engineering Management from the University of Central Florida.
